messages:
ana.docs: Heads-up — next week we have 3 people OOO (Jessie Tue/Wed, Sam Thu/Fri, and Lina on PTO Mon). I'm proposing temporary reviewer lanes to avoid PRs stalling. Quick sketch below, please react or suggest swaps.

ana.docs: Lanes (short):
- snippets: mike.eng + karim_prod
- migration guides: ana.docs + mike.eng
- API reference: karim_prod
- examples/tutorials: ana.docs
- link/typo/quick fixes: reviewer-on-duty (rotating, default mike.eng)

ana.docs: Constraints: keep any >4-file changes to canary merge window (Tues 3–4pm PT) and run docs-preview. Small fixes (<3 files) can merge after one reviewer + green preview.

mike.eng: ok on snippets + quick fixes. will pick up the reviewer-on-duty slot for Tue/Wed.

jessie: thanks — I can do migration guide reviews remotely Tue morning, but I won't be able to merge after 2pm on Wed. if something needs handoff ping me in thread.

karim_prod: can take API ref and help with snippet reviews Thurs morning. can also cover merge window if mike is AFK.

ana.docs: Cool. Two notes: 1) please add label `docs/expedite` for anything customer-facing regression; 2) use this PR checklist for preview: `ci/docs-preview` must be green + include screenshots for UI changes.

sam_platform: on-call conflict Thu/Fri so won't be able to review large migration PRs. I'll aim to do small link fixes from my phone.

ana.docs: For backlog ordering — I'll triage tomorrow and mark urgent PRs with `docs/priority:high`. If you see a high label and can't review, please propose a replacement or escalate to #eng-plat for coverage.

mike.eng: quick question — how long is docs-preview queue currently? don't want merges to back up during the canary window.

docs-bot: ci/docs-preview queued (approx 8–10m) — current average runtime 9m (last 10 runs).

ana.docs: thanks — so plan: hold canary merges to Tue 3–4pm PT, team watches queue at 2:45pm and stop new preview runs 2:55pm. If preview is queued at 3:00pm we wait; if green, merge; if red, rollback and open follow-up.

karim_prod: locking that window. also recommend tagging `merge-windows:canary` on PRs to make triage easier.

jessie: I can swap a migration PR review to karim if needed. mike — can you take over my open snippet PRs Mon if I don't finish?

mike.eng: yes I can pick them up Mon morning. can you list which ones?

jessie: posted links in thread — PTAL: https://git/repo/pulls/238, https://git/repo/pulls/241. small changes.

ana.docs: Action items:
- mike.eng: snippets + Tue/Wed reviewer-on-duty (confirmed)
- karim_prod: API ref + help Thurs reviews (confirmed)
- ana.docs: migration + examples triage (confirmed)
- rotation: mike -> karim -> ana for reviewer-on-duty next week

ana.docs: If anyone wants to swap a lane, react with :hand: and propose who replaces you. I'll update the tracking doc after lunch.

mike.eng: :thumbsup: added to both PR links and put `docs/expedite` on one customer blocker.

karim_prod: :hand: happy to swap if mike needs to take an infra sprint late next week — will update the doc if that happens.

ana.docs: thanks — I'll follow up with the triage doc + put a calendar hold for Tue canary merge window.

sam_platform: noted. I'll try to clear any tiny link fixes before Thu.

ana.docs: perfect — closing the thread for now, will repost if anything shifts.
